s1.syndrome_frame: Postoperative corneal inflammation with deep stromal involvement
salient_findings: Brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma
Central infiltrate involving all corneal layers on optical coherence tomography
key_facts: 68-year-old man with pseudophakic bullous keratopathy
Underwent DSAEK in the right eye
Postoperative course was initially uneventful under topical and systemic corticosteroids
History of eye infection by Thaumetopoea pityocampa 9 months before DSAEK
Best-corrected visual acuity was 20/200 in the right eye
Pupils were isocoric and isoreactive without an afferent pupillary defect
No pain with ocular movements
Slit-lamp biomicroscopy showed brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma
Anterior chamber was deep and clear
Intraocular pressure and fundus examination were normal

shortlist.label: Fungal keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma are consistent with fungal infection

shortlist.label: Acanthamoeba keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of eye infection and deep stromal involvement are risk factors for Acanthamoeba keratitis

shortlist.label: Bacterial keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Postoperative corneal inflammation with deep stromal involvement could be caused by bacterial infection

shortlist.label: Nocardia keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Nocardia is a rare but possible cause of postoperative keratitis, especially with deep stromal involvement

shortlist.label: Aspergillus keratitis
shortlist.why_kept: Aspergillus is a common cause of fungal keratitis, and the patient's history of eye infection and deep stromal involvement make it a plausible diagnosis

trace.fact: Surgical history: Descemet Stripping Automated Endothelial Keratoplasty (DSAEK) in the right eye
Postoperative treatment: topical and systemic corticosteroids
Previous infection: Thaumetopoea pityocampa (pine processionary) eye infection 9 months before DSAEK
Time to referral: 2 months after DSAEK
Chief complaint: keratitis in the right eye
Slit-lamp biomicroscopy findings (right eye): brown, multilobular lesions in the deep corneal stroma
